solves.reasoning: (A) frightened: seeks mother for protection/safety. (B) comforted: comforted and reassured. (C) monoculture: cultivating only one species.
(A) social bonds: evolved to establish strong bonds. (B) myriad: a myriad of needs. (C) ripened: crops that ripened or were stored.
(A) voluntary: self-imposed restraints. (B) impelling: equally strong impulse. (C) spectrum: spectrum of transformations (one end...other end).
rigid is wrong; original 'flexible' means social group definition is flexible, not rigid.
isolation is wrong; 'cannot exist too long without seeking companionship' — isolation contradicts the context.
welcome is wrong; rats, mice, roaches are unwanted species, not welcome.
comforted and reassured — the blank needs 'reassured' to complete the pair.
pets, dolls or even cars and memorabilia — listing non-human objects we attribute characteristics to.
an identity that is unique and separate from anyone else — identity fits with unique/separate.
maintained = sustained (kept going throughout childhood years).
relate to = connect with (empathize with pets' needs).
cultivating = growing (raising/farming one species).
anxious ↔ composed (calm, not nervous).
confirm ↔ deny (opposite of confirming existence).
(A) play a part = fulfill a role; (B) play activity = recreation/leisure.
Large grass area, few trees, eastern Europe/Asia = steppe (Eurasian steppe).
see animals as distinct from humans — adjective form of distinguish needed after 'as'.
rates of survival and reproduction — noun form parallel to 'survival'.
forest gardening mimicked natural growth and left minimal traces on the land.
cannot exist for too long without seeking companionship — need for others.
